palette_name: Connected medium green meadow, shaded living-turf bank only
lower_description: Existing normal short farm grass terrain: mostly a flat solid muted medium green #43894f, with extremely sparse tiny 1-2 pixel grass strokes in #4e9557 and #397d48. Simple clean low-detail cozy farming-game pixel art, 16x16 tiles. Match this dark normal grass as the lower ground. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front edge, ground top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No flowers, stones, weeds, bushes, shadows from objects or outlines around tiles.
upper_description: Preserve the supplied connected upper grass tile exactly, keeping the same flat top colour and tiny sparse strokes; preserve the supplied lower meadow too. A shallow 3-4 pixel grassy raised lawn. The ENTIRE vertical front face and every side edge are living GREEN TURF with tiny short green hanging blades. Convey height with a thin medium-green lip and darker green foot shadow. No brown, yellow, exposed dirt, earth or stone. VERY ORGANIC pond-shore silhouette: winding S-curves, asymmetrical rounded lobes and little inward bays, shifting 2-4 pixels sideways inside each tile. No geometric rectangles, ruler-straight edges, block corners or repeated stair steps. Simple cozy 16px farm pixel art. Straight-on front-facing 2D game view, horizontal front facade, top visible slightly from above; no isometric, diagonal or three-quarter side view. No plants, flowers, props or large grass tufts.
transition_description: All-green GRASS-COVERED bank that follows a strongly crooked pond shoreline. A frayed green turf rim with small outward curls and inward indentations every few pixels, S-shaped edge profiles and rounded concave/convex corners. The rim must vary by 2-4 pixels within EVERY edge tile, no long straight segments. A short darker-green grassy face and narrow dark contact shadow, never a brown soil wall. Keep seams compatible with the supplied upper and lower bases.
